advisories.reason: Dev-only: @vscode/vsce 4.0.0 -> @azure/identity 4.13.3 -> @azure/msal-node 6.0.1. The flaw is in MSAL Node's authorization code flow. vsce loads @azure/identity only to publish with Azure credentials, and no workflow runs vsce publish; the extension has no npm runtime dependencies. The fix is msal-node 7.1.0, and no @azure/identity release accepts msal-node 7 yet. Remove this entry when an @azure/identity release does and the lockfile takes it; the gate fails once npm stops reporting the advisory.
